howto: Click the big cookie to bake. Every click also earns a share of your cookies-per-second rate, so clicking never becomes useless.
Open the STORE on the right and buy buildings — Cursor, Grandma, Wheat Field, Sugar Mine and up — each adds cookies per second. The 1 / 10 / 100 / MAX buttons set how many you buy at once.
Buy upgrades as they unlock: they multiply the buildings, and the kitten line multiplies everything by your milk.
Golden cookies appear on their own for a few seconds. Click one for a 7x production Frenzy (60 seconds), a 20x click frenzy (15 seconds), or a lucky windfall of cookies.
Feats unlock as milestones are reached and each one raises your milk. When all-time cookies reach a billion, the Legacy button ascends the run for permanent Golden Dough.
tips: Buy in tens or hundreds once you can afford it: bulk prices are a discount versus buying one at a time.
A production Frenzy is the moment to spend, and stacking a click frenzy on top is the biggest spike in the game.
Milk comes from feats and the kittens multiply by it — chasing feats is a real income path, not decoration.
Offline earnings are capped at 12 hours and pay at your current rate, so coming back after a day is a payday.
Legacy level is the cube root of all-time cookies: the first billion is the first ascension, and every level is a permanent +2% cookies per second.

controls.keyboard: Mouse only: click the cookie, click store rows to buy. 1 / 10 / 100 / MAX set the buy amount; the bottom bar switches Stats, Feats, Legacy and Options.
controls.touch: Tap the cookie, tap rows in the store to buy, and tap the bottom bar for Stats, Feats, Legacy and Options. The game is happy in portrait.

difficulty: No modes: one long curve. Each building costs 15% more than the last of its kind, upgrades multiply what they make, and Legacy resets the run for permanent Golden Dough — the genre-standard prestige loop.

features.offline-earnings: Cookies accrue while the tab is closed, capped at 12 hours at your current rate
features.upgrade-tree: 28 upgrades multiply buildings, clicks and golden cookies; 12 building tiers from Cursor to Time Machine
features.big-number-format: Counts run in K / M / B / T / Qa through the counter, store and stats
features.prestige-or-next-goal: Feats fire every few minutes early on; the Legacy panel opens at the first billion all-time cookies and shows the next Golden Dough level
features.autosave: Saves every few seconds and when the tab hides; a full progress wipe lives in Options
